native_sampling.stock_section: Actual emitted slab mid-plane on exact print STL. Lines polygonized by even/odd crossing. Components above 0.01 mm2 receive explicit model wall paths; smaller sections retained separately.
native_sampling.boundary_sampling: At most 2 mm along every outer and hole perimeter, comparing nearest emitted wall centreline and its own half width. The 0.30 mm review trigger includes the 0.15 mm first-layer XY compensation and layer-midplane versus slicer-slab approximation. This is not a dimensional acceptance tolerance.
native_sampling.scope: Detects missing stock components or omitted perimeter regions despite a successful slicer result. Sparse interior infill is not treated as an omission; does not establish physical bond, surface finish, or load capacity.

perimeter_review.scope: All actual model slabs have finite left-tool paths and every whole stock component receives model walls. Nineteen surface triggers are named by exact functional source/native geometry with complete bearing and local-road proof. The final curved mounting-annulus terminal shortfall remains explicit; this is not a zero-dimensional-error claim or physical insert-retention qualification.
